text: No, FIRMS did not detect any thermal anomalies within the property from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. All sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) fully covered the property every day during this period, but recorded zero thermal detections. However, this does not rule out small, short-lived, or obscured fires. The data only confirms no *detected* anomalies, not the absence of fire itself.
